statement: A face-down card shows nothing of what it is but its kind where its zone shows it: a monster in a Monster Zone, a Spell or Trap in a Spell & Trap Zone; a face-down banished card shows nothing. So where an effect checks a card for anything else, the card must be face-up where it could be face-down, unless the effect's words say otherwise.
scripts: ocgcore and the scripts agree (a face-down card has no properties to check).
